document.abstract: To facilitate interchange, this specification defines specific text and binary representations for digital object identifier (DOI) names and Entertainment ID Registry (EIDR) Identifiers. It also defines dictionary entries, e.g. types and elements, for use in MXF and other KLV-based applications.
